title: DOW-UAP-D082, Narrative Statement 4, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A first-hand witness narrative statement (image format) provided to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) by a federal law enforcement special agent regarding a UAP sighting.
interpretation_warnings: No body text was extractable from this image-format document; all facts are derived solely from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
The document is a single-witness narrative (Witness 4 of several), meaning it reflects one individual's account.
The exact location within the western United States is not specified in available metadata.
Without the actual narrative text, the specific details of what was observed, duration, appearance, and behaviour of the UAP are unknown.

verifiable_claims.claim: Multiple U.S. federal law enforcement special agents observed UAP over two days in October 2023 in the western United States
Witness 4 provided a first-hand narrative to AARO
